en.joke: I finally achieved digital detox. Now I just scroll through photos of other people's digital detoxes.
en.explanation: It's funny because it satirizes the performative nature of 'digital detox' and how we consume even 'offline' experiences online.

people.name: Helen Coonan
people.extract: Helen Lloyd Coonan is a former Australian politician who was a Senator for New South Wales from 1996 to 2011, representing the Liberal Party. She was a minister in the Howard government, serving as Minister for Revenue and Assistant Treasurer from 2001 to 2004 and then as Minister for Communications, Information Technology and the Arts from 2004 to 2007.
highlights: Minister for Revenue and Assistant Treasurer (2001-2004).
Minister for Communications, IT and the Arts (2004-2007).

people.name: Ahmed al-Sharaa
people.extract: Ahmed Hussein al-Sharaa, also known by his former nom de guerre Abu Mohammad al-Julani, is a Syrian statesman and former rebel commander who has served as the president of Syria since 2025. As the emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and the de facto leader of the Syrian Salvation Government (SSG) during the Syrian civil war, he led the decisive Syrian opposition offensives that resulted in the fall of the Assad regime in 2024.
highlights: Led offensives resulting in fall of Assad regime.

people.name: Bob Ross
people.extract: Robert Norman Ross was an American painter and art instructor who created and hosted The Joy of Painting, an instructional television program that aired from 1983 to 1994 on PBS in the United States and CBC in Canada.
highlights: Created and hosted "The Joy of Painting".
Program aired on PBS from 1983 to 1994.
